# RasiVani

> RasiVani (https://rasivani.com) is a free Vedic astrology website for Indian families, in 10 languages: English (en), हिन्दी (hi), தமிழ் (ta), తెలుగు (te), ಕನ್ನಡ (kn), മലയാളം (ml), मराठी (mr), বাংলা (bn), ગુજરાતી (gu), ଓଡ଼ିଆ (or). It makes a jathagam / janam kundli (birth chart), checks marriage porutham (10 poruthams), shows the daily panchangam with Rahu kalam, and publishes a fresh rasi palan (daily horoscope) for all 12 rasis every day at 00:05 IST.

Calculations use the sidereal zodiac with Lahiri (Chitrapaksha) ayanamsa, Vimshottari dasha and the ten South Indian poruthams. Birth details are processed in the visitor's browser and are never stored. Astrology is presented as cultural tradition, not as medical, financial or legal advice.

## Rasi, nakshatra and festival pages (updated every day)
- [12 rasis in Tamil](https://rasivani.com/rasi/ta/): one page per rasi at https://rasivani.com/rasi/ta/<rasi>/ (mesha ... meena) with nature, nakshatra padas, lucky day, colour and number, today's palan and this month's palan with chandrashtamam dates
- [27 nakshatras in Tamil](https://rasivani.com/nakshatra/ta/): one page per star at https://rasivani.com/nakshatra/ta/<star>/ (ashwini ... revati) with rasi, lord, deity, gana, yoni, rajju, best matching stars, today's tara balam and this month's good days
- [Festivals and vrat days in Tamil](https://rasivani.com/festivals/ta/) and [in Telugu](https://rasivani.com/festivals/te/): Karthigai Deepam / Karthika Pournami, Vaikunta (Mukkoti) Ekadasi, Pongal / Makara Sankranti, and one page for every amavasya and pournami (for example https://rasivani.com/festivals/ta/amavasya-november-2026/) with exact tithi start and end times in IST
